title: Sign Equation Indicator
statement: For signs $a,b,c,r\in\{-1,1\}$, the indicator of the equation $abc=r$ is $\frac{1+rabc}{2}$, where the indicator is $1$ when the equation holds and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $a,b,c,r$ are integer units, hence signs in $\{-1,1\}$
